text:
The Willow planning meetings (3–10 Nov) covered six modules: indexer, feed, session, notify, ingest, and webhooks. Session and ingest share worker alpha, and feed and webhooks share another worker. Session and webhooks never share a worker, and bench.py and client.py belong to session. Feed must not depend on indexer, even indirectly.

Configuration rules: notify.retry_limit must be exactly 4. If it exceeds 1, feed.max_workers must be at most 6. notify.timeout_s is 90 (corrected from 15). If it exceeds 80, ingest.batch_size must be at least 800. webhooks.ttl_s is 510 (corrected from 330), and the client specifies ingest.ttl_s as 390.

Dependencies: session depends on notify, ingest depends on session, and feed rolls out before session.

Schedule: code review should take under one day, and the security review is at month end.

The team leans against separate databases for indexer, session, and feed. A shared metrics library, a new linter, and naming conventions are parked.
